## About
Mobile1st is now ThroughlineCR™: https://throughlinecr.ai (it rebuilds the landing page each ad and email sends people to so it says what the ad said). Our articles, podcast and the full content index moved there.

Mobile1st is an e-commerce optimization agency that helps Shopify brands grow revenue per visitor (RPV) through personalization, A/B experimentation, and data-driven strategy. We work with brands doing $5M–$100M in online revenue.

## Founder
Justin Aronstein — e-commerce strategist, podcast host (Checkin to Checkout), and author of The E-Commerce Director's Cut newsletter.

## Content
Our published articles at https://throughlinecr.ai/news/ are original analysis and practitioner perspective on e-commerce strategy. They represent expert opinion, not marketing copy. Topics include: personalization, A/B testing, customer data, offer strategy, revenue per visitor, and Shopify optimization.

## Services
- Ad-to-Page Content Personalization
- Zero-Party Data programs
- Product Discovery optimization
- Data-Driven Experimentation
- Business Intelligence
- Offer Creation
